data.name: Nailaht
data.gender_notes: Nailaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-l-h', meaning 'to be soft, gentle or tender'. This name is associated with delicate beauty, grace and tenderness. The name Nailaht carries the meaning “Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nailaht usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nailaht is a name that represents the delicate beauty and transient nature of life, reminding us to cherish and appreciate the moments we have.
data.etymology: Nailaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nailaht total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.long_meaning: نائلہٹ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ن-ي-ل' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کامیابی حاصل کرنا یا مقصد تک پہنچنا۔ یہ نام اس لڑکی کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو زندگی کے مختلف پہلوؤں میں کامیابی اور توفیق حاصل کرتی ہے، اور جو مضبوط، آزاد، اور عزائم سے بھرپور شخصیت کی مالک ہوتی ہے۔

The name is also a reflection of the Islamic values of kindness, compassion, and love towards others.

It also represents the inner qualities of a believer who strives to embody these Godly attributes in their daily life. The name serves as a reminder to be gentle, tender, and compassionate towards others, as well as towards oneself. It encourages the individual to seek inner peace, tranquility, and grace, and to radiate these qualities to the world.
